### M-tron Industries, Inc. to Report Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results on August 12, 2026 and Host Conference Call on August 13, 2026


August 03, 2026


ORLANDO, Fla.


, Aug. 3, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- M-tron Industries, Inc. (NYSE American: MPTI) ("Mtron" or the "Company"), a U.S.-based supplier of radio frequency components and solutions to the aerospace & defense, avionics and space industries, will report financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026, after the market closes on Wednesday August 12, 2026. Mtron's press release will be available on the Investor Relations website at[ir.mtron.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4742906-1&h=2387801581&u=https%3A%2F%2Fir.mtron.com%2F&a=ir.mtron.com) .


Mtron will also host a conference call on Thursday August 13, 2026, at 10:30 a.m. ET to review these results. To access the conference call, please use the dial-in information below:

**About Mtron**


M-tron Industries, Inc. (NYSE American: MPTI) designs, manufactures, and markets highly engineered, high reliability frequency and spectrum control products and solutions. As an engineering-centric company, Mtron provides close support to its customers throughout our products' entire life cycle, including product design, prototyping, production, and subsequent product upgrades. Mtron has design and manufacturing facilities in Orlando, Florida, and Yankton, South Dakota, a sales office in Hong Kong, and a manufacturing facility in Noida, India. For more information, visit[www.mtron.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4742906-1&h=2152473833&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.mtron.com%2F&a=www.mtron.com) .
